items.summary: A flaw was found in CRI-O. Any authenticated user, including a user with no permissions, could download a diagnostic archive with the server log files, the host process list, a file system…

items.title: Lldpd: lldpd: out-of-bounds read in liblldpctl on a short lldp-med location
items.summary: A flaw was found in lldpd. The service fails to verify that Link Layer Discovery Protocol - Media Endpoint Discovery (LLDP-MED) location records received from network neighbors match their declared lengths. An adjacent attacker on the local network can exploit this flaw by sending crafted packets, causing client applications using the liblldpctl library to read past buffer boundaries when parsing location data.…

items.title: Uninitialized heap disclosure in CONNECT through Will payload length truncation
items.summary: In Eclipse versions 1.5-1.6.13, 2.0.0-2.0.22 and 2.1.0-2.1.2, the client library libmosquitto does not reject Will messages with payloads greater than 65535 bytes when calling mosquitto will set() or mosquitto will set v5() . This results in up to 65535 bytes of uninitialised heap memory being transmitted as the Will. This can be mitigated by only passing payloads with a maximum length of 65535 bytes.
